binding: DataBindingEdit::Set.id and DataBinding.id are author-selected view-local logical binding names referenced by code, not globally stable entity or placement UUIDs. They are not creation aliases or created-result entries.
constraints: Each view definition has unique nonempty binding names, UTF-8 length at most128 bytes; names are case-sensitive.
Keep may retain only an existing binding of the same parent view after expectedRevision CAS, including its protected foreign reference/capture; it cannot copy an invisible reference across views.
Set remains subject to normal scope/ACL/reference validation. A binding name confers no permission and is never a principal.
The server-assigned/non-reused UUID rule applies to namespace entities and placements, not view-local logical binding names.
CreateView defines bindings only through Set. Duplicate names in any resulting definition reject the whole mutation before publication; no first/last-write winner.

Within UpdateView, Set at an existing name is an explicit replacement under parent expectedRevision CAS. Rename is represented by omitting the previous name and adding Set with the new name; an unavailable protected target cannot be renamed by Keep or guessed replacement.
Any binding or code change advances the parent view revision and invalidates the old host view generation/bridge. A retained logical name does not carry an old bridge grant into new code.
